summary: Klaviyo commands keep tenant data isolated through MCP, send only API-accepted requests and filters, report failures and retries honestly, and resolve report windows from the user's explicit dates.
reason: An independent max-effort review traced tenant-isolation holes reachable through the MCP server, sync options that silently did nothing or changed state, and a qa-gate request Klaviyo rejects with HTTP 400 (confirmed live).
validated_outcome: Regression tests for each finding; go build, go vet and go test ./... pass; live against a real Klaviyo account: qa-gate --campaign-id returns a verdict, every sync --since filter is accepted, default receipts still write.
